$comment: Shared voice engine resolution contract (voice-catalog/v2). decodeCases lock how clients decode the catalog (unknown fields — including the retired v1 price / features / source / acceptedFormats — ignored, unknown transport entries dropped, malformed entries dropped alone); resolveCases lock which engine is actually used after a catalog revision change or a connection change; optionCases lock the engine sheet. catalog "base" = the data object of shared/model-contracts/voice_catalog_contract.v2.json (Server handler output); otherwise an inline document. realtimeDecodeCases / realtimeResolveCases / realtimeOptionCases lock the conversation engine (realtime[]) the same way; they decode with decodeRealtimeCatalog and never change the stt / tts groups.

decode: Decode data of GET /api/metadata?view=voice (schemaVersion 2). Optional fields: null ≡ missing; compare decoded typed values, not JSON text. Unknown keys at any level are ignored (no decode failure), including the retired v1 keys price, features, source, acceptedFormats and shutdownAt. A providerKind the client has no enum case for is dropped; constants.knownProviderKinds is the full raw-value set of both clients' ProviderKind enum and each client asserts its enum equals it. Never filter by which kinds have voice entries today. Entries whose transport is unknown are dropped. An entry whose required field has the wrong type (model / path / outputFormat not string, maxBytes / maxDurationSec / maxChars not an integer >= 1, voices not an array) is dropped alone; a voice whose id is not a string is dropped; a tts entry left with no voices is dropped. languageField that is not a string = missing. speedRange (tts, optional) is kept only when min and max are finite numbers with 0 < min <= 1 <= max; otherwise it is missing (the entry stays, without speed control). isDefault that is not true = false; missing isDefault (entry or voice) = false. A missing direction or provider decodes to empty arrays. Malformed structure never fails the document: providers or a provider that is not an object = empty, a direction that is not an array = empty, an entry or voice that is not an object = dropped.

The decoded view keeps only the keys listed in expected. Every stt entry in the catalog is uploaded as m4a (the catalog lists only m4a-capable dictation entries); there is no upload-format field to check.
resolve: Order: selection system → system (no notice, keep); connection missing or of another providerKind → connection_missing; authMode != apiKey or no key → key_missing; entry (providerKind, direction, model) absent in the current revision — including an empty direction or a vanished provider — → entry_removed (fall back to system, no silent switch to another model).
Every fallback sets notice = true (show once on the settings row and once at next use) and persist = system (the stored selection is rewritten to system).
tts: a selected voice that is not in the entry voices → the entry default voice (isDefault), else the first voice.
options: Engine sheet: system first; then, in connections order, every connection with authMode apiKey and a key whose providerKind has entries in that direction lists all entries in catalog order. Unusable combinations are not listed (never greyed out).
pending: Engine sheet footnote (D-21): in connections order, the distinct providerKinds of connections (any authMode, with or without a key) that have no entry in that direction of the decoded catalog — including kinds the client does not know and providers missing from the catalog. Kinds that do have entries are never listed, even when their connection is unusable. Empty list = no footnote. Only computed when a catalog is available; when the catalog is unavailable (404) or failed to load with no cache, the sheet shows that state instead of this footnote.
realtime: Conversation engine: realtime[] is decoded separately (decodeCatalog keeps only stt / tts, so the older groups are unchanged). Entry kept when transport ∈ constants.realtimeTransports, model / path are strings, contextWindow is an integer >= 1 and voices is an array; voices with a non-string id are dropped and an entry left with no voices is dropped. maxSessionSec that is not an integer >= 1 is missing (entry stays); inputTranscriptionModel that is not a string is missing, and an openai_realtime / xai_realtime entry without it is dropped (user transcription is off by default there, so the user turns could not be stored; gemini_live needs no model); isDefault not true = false. Same provider-kind and malformed-structure rules as decode.

Resolve and options use the resolve / options rules with direction realtime: engine system means follow the current chat model (the cascade conversation); a cloud selection falls back to it with the same reasons, notice and persist; a selected voice not in the entry voices → the entry default voice, else the first. The settings row lists exactly the options; the client never hard-codes which providers have a realtime engine.

decodeCases.note: Every providerKind in constants.knownProviderKinds is decoded, not only the kinds that have voice entries today; only kinds outside both clients' enum are dropped. Guards the 2026-10-19 split (iOS decoded any enum kind, Android and the reference only four).
